notices.short_title: NOTICE OF REOPENING OF PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD ON PROPOSED RULES
notices.description:
Notice of Reopening of Public Comment Period on Proposed Rules

 

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Board of Correction is reopening the public comment period for the proposed rules concerning amendments to the Boards Minimum Standards related to mental health and health care. These rule proposals were first published in the City Record on January 12, 2026.
notices.plain: The Board of Correction has reopened the public comment period on its proposed rules amending minimum standards for mental health and health care, first published Jan. 12, 2026.

notices.short_title: DSNY Proposed Implementation Dates Regarding Brooklyn East, Manhattan Northeast, Queens West, and Manhattan West CWZs
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation will hold a public hearing on Aug. 25, 2026, on proposed implementation dates for commercial waste zones in Brooklyn East, Manhattan Northeast, Queens West and Manhattan West.

notices.short_title: Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 1 LED Lighting Install
notices.description: Brooklyn Bridge Park is an eighty-five (85) acre waterfront park in Brooklyn, NY. The Pier 1 section of the park is in need of lighting improvements to replace the aging metal halide lights installed during the build-out of the park. All proposed LED light fixtures will need to be tied into a recently installed new lighting panel. Brooklyn Bridge Park is Seeking proposals for an electrical contractor to remove the existing metal halide lighting fixtures and install the LED lighting fixtures and associated wiring. ??
notices.plain: Brooklyn Bridge Park is seeking proposals from electrical contractors to replace the aging metal halide lights on Pier 1 with LED fixtures, with responses due Aug. 5, 2026.

notices.short_title: Degraw Firehouse Renovation
notices.description: This project consists of the interior renovation and change of use of the decommissioned FDNY firehouse at 299 Degraw Street, Brooklyn to house the Noel Pointer Foundation non-profit music school. Construction scope will include restoration of exterior masonry and replacement of windows and doors. partial underpinning of existing party wall on west side as well as new mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, security, IT, and AV systems. CB: Brooklyn 6
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded APN Construction Corp a $10,288,484 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to renovate the former FDNY firehouse at 299 Degraw Street in Brooklyn into a music school for the Noel Pointer Foundation.

notices.short_title: 85026I0005-LBC21MNRF, CM-Build for Macon Library
notices.description: This project is to preserve and modernize the historic library facility while addressing critical infrastructure deficiencies that impact building performance, occupant comfort, and long-term operations.
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking competing proposals, due Aug. 18, 2026, from firms to serve as construction manager-builder for work to preserve and modernize the historic Macon Library, including repairs to its infrastructure.

notices.short_title: SMD_A&CM_ RFQ 517896 - LOBBY RENOVATIONS AT ODWYER GARDENS & CONEY ISLAND SITE 8
notices.description:
Scope of Work:

The base scope of work includes but is not limited to lobby renovations at Surfside Gardens Buildings SG-1 through SG-5. The work includes the installation of new storefront entrance systems with intercoms and key-fob access controls, construction of new recycling rooms with ventilation, key-fob access, and opaque exterior walls, installation of decorative art panels within the lobbies, patching and painting of existing ceilings as required, replacement of ceiling light fixtures were indicated on the plans, installation of new exit signage, and the addition of security cameras serving the recycling rooms.
notices.plain: The New York City Housing Authority is seeking bids for lobby renovations at Surfside Gardens Buildings SG-1 through SG-5, with responses due Aug. 19, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Notice of Award to Unwind Hospitality LLC for the development, operation, and maintenance of a snack bar and merchandise concession with the option of a full-service restaurant at the Orchard Beach Pavilion
notices.description:
The City of New York Department of Parks & Recreation ('Parks') has awarded a concession to Unwind Hospitality LLC (Concessionaire), of 85 Broad St. Suite 17-004, New York, NY 10004, for the development, operation, and maintenance of a snack bar and merchandise concession with the option of a full-service restaurant at the Orchard Beach Pavilion, Pelham Bay Park, Bronx. The concession, which was solicited by a Negotiated Concession, will operate pursuant to a license for one (1) twenty (20) year term. Concessionaire shall pay to the City license fees consisting of the greater of a guaranteed minimum annual fee versus a percentage of gross receipts:  

OPERATING YEAR         MINIMUM ANNUAL FEE   OR      % OF ANNUAL GROSS RECEIPTS
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Unwind Hospitality LLC a 20-year concession to develop, operate and maintain a snack bar and merchandise stand, with an option for a full-service restaurant, at Orchard Beach Pavilion in the Bronx, worth $5,138,936 to the city.
